description: This is a PHP source file defining a controller class 'VoucherTheme' within the OpenCart admin module, specifically for managing voucher themes in the sale section. The class includes methods for listing, editing, and saving voucher themes, and handles rich interactions with the web application's framework, models, and views.

classes.name: VoucherTheme
classes.description: Controller class managing voucher themes in the OpenCart admin sale module, including listing, editing, and saving voucher themes with support for multilingual descriptions and image management.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the voucher theme page, loads language resources, sets up the page title, processes URL parameters for sorting and pagination, and displays the list view of voucher themes.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to display the list of voucher themes by calling getList() and sending the output to the response.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Builds and returns the HTML view for the list of voucher themes, including handling sorting, pagination, and retrieving voucher themes from the model.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares and displays the form for creating or editing a voucher theme, including loading existing data, images, and language options.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the POST request to save a voucher theme, including permission checks, validation, and updating or creating the voucher theme record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of selected voucher themes, performing permission checks, deleting from the model, and returning a JSON success or error message.
